data.title: Manufacturing’s Next Phase: From AI Pilots to Autonomous Decisions on the Factory Floor  | RoboticsTomorrow
data.description: Manufacturers that scale successfully tend to begin with one line that has measurable scrap or changeover pain, build clean and time stamped machine data before adding models, and decide in advance what each system may adjust on its own and who owns the outcome.
